name: Beechcraft T-34 Mentor
summary: Bonanza-derived tandem two-seat military trainer; piston A/B models are popular civil warbirds.

engines: Single flat-six in a slim cowl with two-blade prop (turboprop C has a longer nose with exhaust stacks)
fuselage: Tandem two-seat cockpit under a long, multi-framed canopy
tail: Swept fin with conventional low horizontal tail

tellTales: Small tandem trainer with a long multi-framed canopy and tricycle gear
Swept fin on a slender rounded fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-52 has a round radial nose and wheels that stay partly exposed when retracted; the T-34 has a slim flat-engine nose.
The CJ-6 has a radial engine and outer wing panels angled sharply upward; the T-34 has a slim cowl and a uniformly tapered wing.
The Texan II is larger, with a turboprop and a one-piece bubble canopy; the T-34 has a framed canopy.

usCount.source: FAA Aircraft Registry make/model query (registered aircraft): T-34, A45 and D45 model codes
